verdict.rationale: Productboard documents an explicitly versioned REST API ('API v2'), with a quickstart and Postman collection for v2, so the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack covers a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees, so the half of the story an agent would rely on for stability is unsupported. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset timelines or headers, version lifecycle and changelog documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: API v2 introduces a new concept: configuration endpoints that describe the shape of data in your workspace.
This Quickstart walks you through your first API call using Productboard's REST API v2.
Get up and running with the Productboard API v2 in Postman in under 5 minutes.
